settings_form.title: File storage
settings_form.description: Where uploads are stored and the limits that apply to them.

backend.label: Storage backend
backend.help: Where files are stored, for example the local filesystem or S3. Changing it needs a restart.

fs_root_path.label: Root folder
fs_root_path.help: Folder on the server where files are saved when using the local filesystem.

s3_bucket.label: Bucket
s3_bucket.help: Name of the bucket uploads go to.

s3_access_key_id.label: Access key ID
s3_access_key_id.help: Access key used to sign in to the bucket.

s3_secret_access_key.label: Secret access key
s3_secret_access_key.help: Secret that goes with the access key ID. It is hidden once saved.

s3_endpoint_url.label: Endpoint URL
s3_endpoint_url.help: Custom endpoint for MinIO, R2 or similar services. Leave blank for Amazon S3.

s3_public_endpoint_url.label: Public endpoint URL
s3_public_endpoint_url.help: Address browsers use for presigned uploads and downloads, when it differs from the endpoint above (for example when the app reaches storage through an internal hostname). Blank uses the endpoint URL.

s3_signature_version.label: Signature version
s3_signature_version.help: Signing method for presigned links. Keep s3v4; most providers reject the older version.

s3_presign_ttl_seconds.label: Presigned link lifetime (seconds)
s3_presign_ttl_seconds.help: How long a presigned download or upload link stays valid.

max_file_size_bytes.label: Maximum file size (bytes)
max_file_size_bytes.help: Largest file a regular upload may have.

allowed_content_types.label: Allowed file types
allowed_content_types.help: List of permitted MIME types. Leave empty to allow any type.

quota_bytes.label: Storage quota (bytes)
quota_bytes.help: Total storage allowed for stored files and uploads in progress. Leave empty for no limit.

public_files_cors.label: Allow cross-origin reads of public files
public_files_cors.help: Lets pages on other sites embed or read public files served by the app. Files redirected to S3 also need CORS configured on the bucket. Applies immediately.

direct_upload_threshold_bytes.label: Resumable upload threshold (bytes)
direct_upload_threshold_bytes.help: Files larger than this are uploaded in parts through a resumable session.

max_direct_upload_bytes.label: Maximum resumable upload size (bytes)
max_direct_upload_bytes.help: Largest file the resumable upload flow accepts.

multipart_part_size_bytes.label: Upload part size (bytes)
multipart_part_size_bytes.help: Preferred size of each part. It grows automatically to stay under 10,000 parts.

upload_session_ttl_seconds.label: Upload session lifetime (seconds)
upload_session_ttl_seconds.help: How long an unfinished upload can still be resumed.

upload_session_retention_days.label: Upload session retention (days)
upload_session_retention_days.help: How long records of finished or aborted upload sessions are kept.
